latestVersion.changelog:
- Credentials are now handled via environment variables (`MYSQL_PWD`, `SSHPASS`) for increased security; passwords are no longer visible in process lists.
- Strongly recommends storing database and SSH passwords in environment variables instead of the config file.
- Updated documentation with usage examples for environment variables and changes to configuration best practices.
- All existing functionality and usage remain unchanged.
